Actual official I2P2.13.0 Java Datagram2/3.make output from the retained offline
run-r2, not reconstructed native wire fixtures. SOURCE.json pins release/source,
actual helper/receipt/stdout and every exact binary leaf. No Java/JAR/download is
needed by ordinary native tests.

For each dsa/ed25519 family: .sender and .recipient are exact serialized synthetic
Destination bytes. .known-test-key is DELIBERATELY PUBLIC, NON-SECRET test data:
DSA exponent1 or the published RFC8032 Ed25519 seed. Never a user/router identity.
For empty, binary,1024,maximum cases: .payload is the exact expected plaintext;
.java2 is signed Datagram2; .java3 is UNSIGNED Datagram3. Maximum is the maximum
payload fitting Datagram2 (DSA62035 /Ed25519 62007), not maximum Datagram3.
Datagram3 does not authenticate its claimed sender. Datagram2 authenticates
signing-key possession and intended recipient, not encryption-key/padding bytes.

Modified azi2pcore equivalence and router/session/client integration stay OPEN.
